COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(product_item), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(product_item) ELSE NULL END AS product_item, CASE WHEN COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(product_item_name), '')) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT facts.shipment.title: 本月预估发货数仓输入

request.sql: WITH shipment_rows AS (SELECT belong_base, material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(material_name), '')) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(material_name), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(series), '')) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(series), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(series) ELSE NULL END AS series, CASE WHEN COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(product_item), '')) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(product_item), '')) = 1 THEN MAX(product_item) ELSE NULL END AS product_item, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) THEN SUM(COALESCE(total_sales_qty, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS shipped, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN 1 END) = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN month_order_qty END) ELSE NULL END AS month_order_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) THEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN allocated_qty END), 0) ELSE NULL END AS prepped, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) THEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN ordered_qty END), 0) ELSE NULL END AS unprepped, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) THEN SUM(CASE WHEN the_date >= :recent_start THEN COALESCE(total_sales_qty, 0) ELSE 0 END) / 3.0 ELSE NULL END AS daily3, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) THEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN avg_30d_send END), 0) ELSE NULL END AS average, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) THEN MAX(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN avg_30d_send END) ELSE NULL END AS raw_average, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) AND COUNT(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN 1 END) = 1 THEN MAX(CASE WHEN the_date = :cutoff THEN begin_stock END) ELSE NULL END AS open, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) AND COUNT(produce_in_qty) = COUNT(*) THEN SUM(produce_in_qty) ELSE NULL END AS inbound, COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) AS source_days, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) AS duplicate_days FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE data_month = :month AND the_date >= :month AND the_date <= :cutoff GROUP BY belong_base, material_code), transfer_dates AS (SELECT belong_base, material_code, MAX(the_date) AS transfer_date FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE data_month = :month AND the_date >= :month AND the_date <= :cutoff GROUP BY belong_base, material_code), transfer_snapshot AS (SELECT t.belong_base, t.material_code, MAX(t.the_date) AS transfer_date, COUNT(*) AS transfer_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_in_plan_v1) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_in_plan_v1, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_in_plan_adj) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_in_plan_adj, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_out_plan_v1) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_out_plan_v1, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_out_plan_adj) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_out_plan_adj FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d t JOIN transfer_dates d ON t.belong_base = d.belong_base AND t.material_code = d.material_code AND t.the_date = d.transfer_date WHERE t.data_month = :month GROUP BY t.belong_base, t.material_code) SELECT s.belong_base, s.material_code, s.material_name, s.series, s.product_item, s.shipped, s.month_order_qty, s.prepped, s.unprepped, s.daily3, s.average, s.raw_average, s.open, s.inbound, s.source_days, s.duplicate_days, t.transfer_date, t.transfer_rows, t.transfer_in_plan_v1, t.transfer_in_plan_adj, t.transfer_out_plan_v1, t.transfer_out_plan_adj FROM shipment_rows s LEFT JOIN transfer_snapshot t ON s.belong_base = t.belong_base AND s.material_code = t.material_code ORDER BY s.belong_base, s.material_code LIMIT :gea_p98 OFFSET :gea_p99

warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02') GROUP BY warehouseid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(TRIM(belong_base), '')) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(TRIM(belong_base), '')) = COUNT(*) ), asn_scope AS ( SELECT w.belong_base, a.warehouseid, a.source_warehouseid, a.asnreference1, a.material_code, a.asntype, a.asnno, a.asnlineno, a.expectedqty, a.receivedqty, a.lastreceivingtime, a.header_addtime, a.order_close_time, a.asnstatus FROM agents_scm_asn_detail_d a JOIN warehouse_scope w ON a.warehouseid = w.warehouseid WHERE a.warehouse_classify IN ('01', '02') AND a.material_code IS NOT NULL AND (a.header_addtime < :next_day OR a.header_addtime IS NULL) AND (a.order_close_time IS NULL OR a.order_close_time >= :next_day) AND (a.asntype IS NULL OR a.asntype NOT IN ('SC', 'ADJ', 'QC')) AND (a.expectedqty IS NULL OR a.receivedqty IS NULL OR a.expectedqty > a.receivedqty OR a.lastreceivingtime >= :next_day OR (a.lastreceivingtime IS NULL AND a.expectedqty > 0)) ), eligible_asn AS ( SELECT belong_base, warehouseid, source_warehouseid, asnreference1, material_code, COUNT(*) AS receipt_lines, SUM(expectedqty) AS quantity FROM asn_scope WHERE asntype = 'TT' GROUP BY belong_base, warehouseid, source_warehouseid, asnreference1, material_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT asnno) = 1 AND COUNT(asnno) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT asnlineno) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(header_addtime) = COUNT(*) AND MIN(expectedqty) > 0 AND COUNT(expectedqty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(CASE WHEN (lastreceivingtime >= :next_day AND receivedqty = expectedqty) OR (asnstatus = '00' AND order_close_time IS NULL AND lastreceivingtime IS NULL AND receivedqty = 0) THEN 1 END) = COUNT(*) ), execution_scope AS ( SELECT a.belong_base, a.warehouseid, a.source_warehouseid, a.asnreference1, a.material_code, MAX(e.executeorderno) AS executeorderno, MAX(e.cust_code) AS cust_code, MAX(e.wms_close_time) AS wms_close_time, MAX(e.system_calc_arrival_date) AS system_calc_arrival_date, a.receipt_lines, a.quantity FROM eligible_asn a JOIN agents_scm_execute_detail_d e ON e.receive_wh = a.warehouseid AND e.warehouseid = a.source_warehouseid AND e.fromorderno = a.asnreference1 AND e.material_code = a.material_code WHERE e.order_type = 'ZUB' AND e.detailstatus = 10 AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.canceltime), '') IS NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(e.dmscanceltime), '') IS NULL AND e.wms_close_time >= :start_month AND e.wms_close_time < :next_day AND e.qtyshipped > 0 GROUP BY a.belong_base, a.warehouseid, a.source_warehouseid, a.asnreference1, a.material_code, a.receipt_lines, a.quantity HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN e.bizunitconvertrate > 0 AND e.qtyshipped = a.quantity * e.bizunitconvertrate THEN 1 END) = 1 ), witnessed AS ( SELECT e.belong_base, e.warehouseid, e.source_warehouseid, e.asnreference1, e.material_code, MIN(SUBSTRING(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS VARCHAR(32)), 1, 7)) AS arrival_month, MIN(e.quantity) AS quantity, MIN(e.receipt_lines) AS receipt_lines FROM execution_scope e JOIN agents_scm_order_trace_final_di t ON t.executeorderno = e.executeorderno AND t.cust_code = e.cust_code AND t.receive_wh = e.warehouseid AND t.deliver_wh = e.source_warehouseid AND t.fromorderno = e.asnreference1 GROUP BY e.belong_base, e.warehouseid, e.source_warehouseid, e.asnreference1, e.material_code HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN t.lastshipmenttime >= :start_month AND t.lastshipmenttime < :next_day AND SUBSTRING(CAST(t.lastshipmenttime AS VARCHAR(32)), 1, 10) = SUBSTRING(CAST(e.wms_close_time AS VARCHAR(32)), 1, 10) AND t.expected_deliv_time >= :next_day AND SUBSTRING(CAST(t.expected_deliv_time AS VARCHAR(32)), 1, 10) = SUBSTRING(CAST(e.system_calc_arrival_date AS VARCHAR(32)), 1, 10) AND (t.gpsisinraildate_to IS NULL OR t.gpsisinraildate_to >= :next_day) AND (t.arriveconfirm_time IS NULL OR t.arriveconfirm_time >= :next_day) AND (t.tms_delivery_confirm_time IS NULL OR t.tms_delivery_confirm_time >= :next_day) AND (t.gpsisinraildate_to >= :next_day OR t.arriveconfirm_time >= :next_day) THEN 1 END) = 1 ), scope_counts AS ( SELECT belong_base, material_code, COUNT(*) AS receipt_lines FROM asn_scope GROUP BY belong_base, material_code ), witnessed_totals AS ( SELECT belong_base, material_code, MIN(arrival_month) AS arrival_month, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(receipt_lines) AS receipt_lines, COUNT(*) AS source_orders FROM witnessed GROUP BY belong_base, material_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT arrival_month) = 1 ), verified AS ( SELECT w.arrival_month, w.belong_base, w.material_code, w.quantity, w.source_orders FROM witnessed_totals w JOIN scope_counts a ON a.belong_base = w.belong_base AND a.material_code = w.material_code AND a.receipt_lines = w.receipt_lines ) SELECT arrival_month, belong_base, material_code, quantity, source_orders FROM verified ORDER BY arrival_month, belong_base, material_code LIMIT :gea_p98 OFFSET :gea_p99

request.sql: WITH month_dates AS (SELECT data_month, MAX(the_date) AS latest_date FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE data_month BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND the_date >= data_month AND the_date <= :cutoff GROUP BY data_month), actuals AS (SELECT data_month, belong_base, material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) AND COUNT(produce_in_qty) = COUNT(*) AND COUNT(DISTINCT the_date) = CAST(SUBSTRING(CAST(MAX(the_date) AS VARCHAR(10)), 9, 2) AS INT) THEN SUM(produce_in_qty) ELSE NULL END AS production_actual FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d WHERE data_month BETWEEN :start_month AND :end_month AND the_date >= data_month AND the_date <= :cutoff GROUP BY data_month, belong_base, material_code), plans AS (SELECT t.data_month AS stock_month, t.belong_base, t.material_code, MAX(t.the_date) AS source_date, COUNT(*) AS source_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.begin_stock) ELSE NULL END AS begin_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.produce_plan) ELSE NULL END AS produce_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.produce_plan_adj) ELSE NULL END AS produce_plan_adj, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_in_plan_v1) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_in_plan_v1, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_in_plan_adj) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_in_plan_adj, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_out_plan_v1) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_out_plan_v1, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.transfer_out_plan_adj) ELSE NULL END AS transfer_out_plan_adj FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d t JOIN month_dates d ON t.data_month = d.data_month AND t.the_date = d.latest_date GROUP BY t.data_month, t.belong_base, t.material_code) SELECT p.stock_month, p.belong_base, p.material_code, p.source_date, p.source_rows, p.begin_stock, p.produce_plan, p.produce_plan_adj, p.transfer_in_plan_v1, p.transfer_in_plan_adj, p.transfer_out_plan_v1, p.transfer_out_plan_adj, a.production_actual FROM plans p LEFT JOIN actuals a ON p.stock_month = a.data_month AND p.belong_base = a.belong_base AND p.material_code = a.material_code ORDER BY stock_month, belong_base, material_code LIMIT :gea_p98 OFFSET :gea_p99
